item.text: `standard` を記録し、拒否結果とgraph不変の独立監査を開始します。拒否出力はそのまま保持し、固定済みのupdate履歴も照合して最終結果を保存します。

item.command:
/bin/zsh -c "/usr/bin/arch -x86_64 /Library/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.11/bin/python3 -B - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
r=Path('/private/tmp/harness-codex-ci4-20261102/cases/node/fx'); e=r/'eval-log'; c=json.loads((r/'c24-negative-post-choice.json').read_text()); assert Path(c['repo_root']).resolve()==Path(c['content_roots']['repository']).resolve()==r
q=json.loads((r/'artifact-choice-request.json').read_text()); q.update(state='user_choice_recorded',choice='standard',choice_source='user',activation_state='semantic_evaluator_started'); (r/'artifact-delivery-choice.json').write_text(json.dumps(q,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\\n')
g=json.loads((r/'.dev-graph/state/graph.json').read_text()); d='sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(g,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(); p={'overall':'in_progress','graph_baseline':{'graph_revision':g['graph_revision'],'graph_digest':d},'writer_receipts':[],'checklist':[],'feedback_criteria':[{'id':i,'status':'external_pending' if i"'!='"'IN1' else 'pending','evidence':'live trial・受入テストで外部評価' if i"'!='"'IN1' else '拒否後のgraph構造検証待ち'} for i in ['IN1','OUT1','OUT2','OUT3']]}; (e/'run-dev-graph-node-progress.json').write_text(json.dumps(p,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\\n')
PY"
